chunks.text: HerTechReady is a 12-week program that helps women make a confident pivot into a tech career — without starting from scratch. You build a portfolio, optimize your LinkedIn, practice your pitch, and graduate at CareerZero where you meet employers face-to-face. 20 women per cohort, 4 cohorts a year, all in English, based in Canada. Tagline: Find the tech seat you were made for. Founded 2016. Website: intelligentnest.ca

HerTechReady is designed for women who have existing professional experience in any field and want to pivot into tech. They are English-speaking and based in Canada. They want structured, cohort-based support, not self-directed online courses. They are ready to commit 12 weeks to building a portfolio, a network, and a career strategy. They want to get hired at a tech company, not start their own business.

HerTechReady is NOT designed for women who want to start their own business or freelance (that is the HerTechTable track), are looking for a short workshop or single event (this is a 12-week commitment), are already working in tech and looking for advanced upskilling, or are based outside Canada.

The HerTechReady program is powered by Nesta's AI platform in three sequential steps. Step 1: Career diagnostic — the participant enters her background and Nesta's AI engine analyzes this against current tech labour market data to produce a personalized career map. Step 2: Personalized learning pathway — a curated upskilling plan matched to the specific role she is pursuing. Step 3: Job matching — Nesta connects her to employers whose open roles match her evolving profile.

HerTechReady program phases: Week 1 is Orientation with baseline assessment, goal setting, cohort community building, and career diagnostic. Weeks 2-4 are Foundation covering AI, the tech labour market, what employers want, and skills gap identification. Weeks 5-7 are Positioning with LinkedIn optimization, positioning statement, and personal brand development. Weeks 8-11 are Activation with job search strategy, mock interviews, 2 group networking sessions, and employer conversations. Week 12 is Transformation with final portfolio presentation, personal pitch, CareerZero preparation, and graduation.

By the end of HerTechReady, every participant has: a complete personal portfolio demonstrating workplace readiness, a documented career transition action plan, an optimized LinkedIn profile with positioning and content strategy, a refined personal pitch and value proposition, a completed mock interview session for tech sector hiring, and a contribution to a collaborative team-based portfolio project.

CareerZero is the quarterly in-person event that closes each HerTechReady cohort. Graduates present their work and meet employers face-to-face. It includes portfolio presentations, structured employer networking, and open networking. Minimum 20 employers attend per year. It is open to the graduating cohort plus any woman in the wider ecosystem who wants to attend and network. Key metric: minimum 60% of participants report that CareerZero conversations were relevant to their job search goals.

HerTechReady outcome TARGETS (not guarantees): 80% of participants report increased confidence presenting to tech employers. 80% have an active optimized LinkedIn profile. 75% report meaningful increase in tech sector connections. 75% are actively applying for tech roles within 30 days. 50% secure an interview or employment offer within 6 months. These are targets, not promises.

If asked about HerTechReady cost: say 'I don't have current pricing details — I'd recommend reaching out to the Intelligent Nest team directly at intelligentnest.ca for the most accurate information.' If asked about next cohort date: say 'Cohorts run quarterly — the best way to get exact dates and availability is to connect with the team at intelligentnest.ca.'
